name: host_powered_off_event
description: RMC subscribes for events; bmcctld reports the Switch-Host powered off; RMC must receive ResourcePoweredOff for the ComputerSystem.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription filtered on ResourceTypes=[ComputerSystem], the resource type host_state_monitor passes to sendEvent(). A RegistryPrefixes filter is not used: bmcweb's getRegistryAndMessageKey() only parses 4-field MessageIds, so five-field ids such as ResourceEvent.1.3.0.ResourcePoweredOff never match a registry filter (same reason the leak cases subscribe without one).

trigger.description: bmcctld reports POWERED_OFF/OFFLINE in HOST_STATE|switch-host (the seed publishes POWERED_ON/ONLINE, so this is a real Running -> Off transition).

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourcePoweredOff event (severity OK) must arrive with OriginOfCondition pointing at the ComputerSystem this BMC serves.

teardown.description: Restore the Switch-Host to On so later tests start clean.

name: host_powered_on_event
description: After the Switch-Host is off, bmcctld reporting it back on must produce a ResourcePoweredOn event.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription filtered on ResourceTypes=[ComputerSystem].

trigger.description: Take the Switch-Host off first (the bridge suppresses no-op transitions, so On -> On would not emit).
Let the powered-off event settle before powering on.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourcePoweredOn event (severity OK) must arrive; the intermediate PoweredOff event is skipped by the matcher.

name: host_powering_off_transitional_event
description: A transitional device_power_state (POWERING_OFF) must surface as ResourcePoweringOff rather than being dropped.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription filtered on ResourceTypes=[ComputerSystem].

trigger.description: bmcctld reports POWERING_OFF while device_status is still ONLINE.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourcePoweringOff event must arrive for the ComputerSystem.

name: host_state_unknown_until_bmcctld_reports
description: Before bmcctld publishes HOST_STATE|switch-host the Switch-Host state is unknown: the ComputerSystem and the Chassis report no PowerState and Status.State UnavailableOffline, and the first row bmcctld writes sets the real state and reaches the RMC as ResourcePoweredOn.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription filtered on ResourceTypes=[ComputerSystem].

trigger.description: Delete the row and restart the bridge, as on a BMC where the bridge starts before bmcctld has published.
The ComputerSystem claims no PowerState and reports UnavailableOffline.
The Chassis, whose power state is derived from the Switch-Host, does the same.
bmcctld publishes its first row: POWERED_ON/ONLINE.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourcePoweredOn event must arrive for the ComputerSystem: the unknown state itself produced no event, the first published state does.
